fusions.name: Gnawing Cloud
fusions.desc: Looses 5 biting specks at once, spread apart, each of which deals 3 damage, with a 25% chance to leave each target [Hindered] for 4 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for each affliction already on the target (max 32%). Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Stripped to the Stalk
fusions.desc: A tearing bite that deals 28 damage, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Ravening Swarm
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to loose a swarm for 12 seconds that bites an enemy within 6 tiles for 3 damage every second. Each kill you make while it is out restores 4 health.

fusions.name: Field Picked Clean
fusions.desc: Every time you kill an enemy, a stack builds on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you are healed for 5% of your maximum health per stack (25% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
